node.text:
Andrej Karpathy believes that beginners in machine learning often focus too much on what they should do instead of how much they are doing. He is a strong believer in the ten thousand hour rule. In his view, becoming an expert is almost deterministic if you put in the necessary time.

The most important step is picking something you actually care about so that you can sustain the effort.

It doesn't matter if you waste some time or iterate through different interests along the way. If you spend ten thousand hours of deliberate effort on an arbitrary subject, you will become an expert in it.

Karpathy finds this idea reassuring because it takes the luck out of success. It means that expertise is a choice you make through consistent work rather than a random outcome of talent or perfect planning.

What looks like “gibberish” in the Epstein files is Base64, a format used in MIME emails to embed attachments like PDFs and images.

Digital forensics enthusiasts have already shown some of this data is recoverable. One of them, Mahmoud Al-Qudsi (mqudsi on X), has been documenting the process in real time.

In short:
• Base64 strings were embedded in DOJ PDFs (that probably shouldn’t have survived redaction)
• OCR failed because it tried to make words — Base64 is not human readable 
• Even tiny errors (like 1 vs l in Courier New) break decoding
• A CNN trained on pixel-level characters solved most issues
• Comparing duplicate email threads fixed the rest

The attachment successfully decoded was a PDF. The contents weren’t that important, but the process matters.

It shows:
– some attachments are recoverable
– redaction/export workflows were sloppy
– more Base64-encoded files are likely still reconstructable

Mahmoud is sharing the full technical breakdown on X if you (understandably) don’t want to support X, he also has a Substack.

This is slow, careful work. Please don’t spread viral claims without fact-checking, misinformation only creates noise and shields people who deserve real accountability.

More updates to come.

Can we just call it an AI, and not a “neural network”? It’s the same thing but fancy words

AI is a super broad catch all term, it can mean anything from a simple script to something way more complex. In this case, I used “convolutional neural network” because it’s more precise about how the problem is being solved.

If you’re trying to tell the difference between a “1” and a lowercase “l” in a flattened image the approach matters. For example sticking it in ChatGPT or another commercial LLM will not give you good results, and was attempted many times. 

A CNN is specifically designed to analyze visual patterns, like tiny differences in pixel structure, spacing, or stroke thickness, that a generic “AI” label doesn’t explain.

For example, saying “AI did it” is like saying “a chef made the dish.” That’s true, but it’s not very helpful if you’re a developer or engineer trying to understand or recreate the solution. Saying “they used a specific technique like a CNN to analyze pixel-level features” actually gives you something more you can work with in understanding the solution.

So yeah, AI is technically correct, but it’s extremely vague, especially to developers,  CNN explains the mechanism, which is the interesting (and useful) part :)

PT:
Marmota é um roedor da família Sciuridae, parente de esquilos, que vive principalmente em regiões frias e montanhosas do hemisfério norte. Do ponto de vista biológico, é um animal escavador e social, que forma tocas complexas para proteção e regulação térmica. A característica mais famosa é a hibernação: em muitos locais, a marmota reduz drasticamente metabolismo e temperatura corporal por meses para sobreviver ao inverno, usando gordura acumulada como “combustível”.

Ecologicamente, marmotas influenciam o solo e a vegetação ao cavar e pastar, e servem de presa para diversos predadores, ajudando a sustentar a cadeia alimentar. Culturalmente, ficaram populares por tradições como o “Dia da Marmota”, que transformou observações sazonais em símbolo de previsão do fim do inverno. Assim, a marmota é um exemplo de adaptação extrema ao clima: comportamento, fisiologia e ambiente trabalhando juntos para atravessar períodos duros.

EN:
A marmot is a rodent in the Sciuridae family (related to squirrels), living mainly in cold and mountainous regions of the Northern Hemisphere. Biologically, it’s a burrowing, social animal that builds complex dens for protection and temperature control. Its best-known trait is hibernation: in many areas, marmots dramatically lower metabolism and body temperature for months to survive winter, relying on stored fat as fuel.

Ecologically, marmots shape soil and vegetation through digging and grazing, and they’re prey for many predators, supporting local food webs. Culturally, they became famous through traditions like Groundhog Day, turning seasonal observations into a symbol for predicting winter’s end. In short, marmots are a clear example of climate adaptation: behavior, physiology, and environment working together to endure harsh seasons.

node.text: It’s a dangerous world out there 🐍 , need to know how to defend 😅

🙌
Hi there everyone, 

Praying this message reaches the right people who genuinely care about our work. 

We are Pockets of Promise.❤️💙💛

A small nonprofit looking to make big dreams come true for children around the world. We are not asking for a donation, but just a simple follow or engagement would help us a lot in gaining more visibility for the kids we support around the world now and in the future.☀️🌎

(We are different and we do care:
100% of our proceeds go directly to the programs our supporters choose to support.)

Please check out our page if you're interested.

Thank you!

Epstein didn’t become powerful because he was a genius investor. Public records never showed consistent, verifiable investment performance like a hedge fund titan. He became powerful because he mastered one thing: access.

Jeffrey Epstein was a college dropout who briefly taught math at the elite Dalton School in New York in the 1970s — despite having no degree.

At Dalton, he built connections with wealthy parents. One of them introduced him to Wall Street circles. By the late 1970s, he was working at Bear Stearns — eventually becoming a limited partner. No finance degree. No formal pedigree. Just proximity to power.

In the 1980s, he launched his own financial advisory firm, claiming he specialized in managing money for billionaires. One of his most important early clients? Leslie Wexner, founder of L Brands (Victoria’s Secret). Wexner handed him extraordinary financial control — including power of attorney.

From there, the network compounded. 

The real scandal isn’t just the crimes.
It’s how many powerful systems enabled him long before the crimes were exposed.

सनातन लोक से सत्य पुरुख ने आकर अपने मूल सत्य ज्ञान से इस कालजाल👹 का भंडा फोड़ किया है.... पृथ्वी के सभी धर्मो में ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश दुर्गाजी और काल ब्रह्म की ही पूजा हो रही है जबकि वेद अनुसार केवल पूर्ण परमात्मा सत्य पुरुष की पूजा का विधान है कोई जिस शक्ति से यह सर्व ब्रह्माण्ड चलायमान है उसका मूल स्रोत सत्य पुरुख यानी सनातन पुरुष हैं..... यह सभी परमात्मा परम पिता सत्य पुरुख के भिखारी हैं लेकिन जिस क्षेत्र क़ो इनको प्रबंधन के लिए दिया था उसमें यह परमात्मा क़ो भूलवा कर खुद क़ो वेद विरुद्ध पूजवाने लगे.... जो कि पाप है.... वेद विरुद्ध हैं....

ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश के आधीन पूरी पृथ्वी पाताल स्वर्ग है यही तीनों शक्तियां इन्हें संभाल रही है... अघोरी शमशान मैं क्या खाते है? गीताजी अनुसार इन रजोगुण तमोगुन सतोगुण की पूजा करने वाले मनुष्यों में नींच राक्षस कहे गये है काल ब्रह्म द्वारा जबकि तीनों क़ो यह कार्य करने की प्रेरणा उनका पिता महाकाल स्वयं देता है... और यह कार्यभार भी महाकाल ने ही अपने प्रथम पुत्र ब्रह्मा, दूसरे पुत्र विष्णु, और तीसरे पुत्र शिव क़ो दें रखा है और इनका पिता महाशिव तथा महाकाल अपने आप क़ो केहलाता है....दोषी अपने बच्चों क़ो बोल रहा है लेकिन स्वयं इनको ऐसे सिस्टम में कार्यरत किया  है जहाँ पाप करने से कोई बच नहीं सकता🙏

Silent SMS أو Type-0 SMS هي رسالة نصية خاصة مُعرّفة ضمن معيار شبكات GSM، تُرسل إلى الهاتف لكنها لا تظهر للمستخدم إطلاقًا:
لا إشعار، لا صوت، ولا تُحفظ في سجل الرسائل، لأنها لا تمر عبر تطبيق الرسائل، بل تُعالَج على مستوى نظام الاتصال الخلوي بين الهاتف والشبكة.
عند استقبال Silent SMS، يقوم الهاتف بالتفاعل مع الشبكة داخليًا فقط لتأكيد أنه نشط ومتصل حاليًا. هذا التفاعل غير مرئي للمستخدم، لكنه يزوّد الشبكة بمعلومة أساسية: أن الجهاز موجود ضمن تغطية خلوية معيّنة وفي لحظة زمنية محددة.
في بعض السيناريوهات، يتم إرسال Silent SMS عدة مرات وعلى فترات مختلفة بهدف:
التأكد المستمر من بقاء الهاتف نشطًا
مراقبة أوقات الاتصال والانقطاع
وربط كل تفاعل بالخلية الخلوية التي استقبلت الإشارة في تلك اللحظة
من خلال تحليل هذه التفاعلات المتكررة وربطها ببيانات الشبكة (مثل الخلايا، قوة الإشارة، وانتقال الهاتف بين الأبراج)، يمكن استنتاج الموقع الجغرافي التقريبي للجهاز. في المدن ذات الكثافة العالية للأبراج، قد يضيق هذا النطاق إلى مئات الأمتار، بينما يكون أوسع في المناطق الريفية.
من المهم تقنيًا التأكيد على أن:
Silent SMS لا تخترق الهاتف
لا تنفّذ أي شيفرة
ولا تمنح وصولًا مباشرًا للجهاز
لكنها تُستخدم كأداة استطلاع ومراقبة صامتة، تسمح بالتأكيد، المتابعة الزمنية، والتتبع التقريبي للموقع الجغرافي دون أن يشعر المستخدم بأي نشاط غير طبيعي.

In Greek mythology, Medusa was a woman whose autonomy was violated—she was raped by a Greek god in Athena’s temple. Instead of receiving protection or justice, she was punished for the violence done to her. Athena transformed her, giving her a power that later generations called a curse: anyone who gazed at Medusa would turn to stone.

But many modern interpretations see this not only as a curse—but as a boundary.

Her gaze became symbolic. No longer could men look at her without consequence. No longer could she be approached, consumed, or violated again. What was framed as monstrosity was actually protection. Power that made harm impossible.

When I say I feel spiritually connected to Medusa, I don’t mean rage or revenge.
I mean self-agency after violation.
I mean boundaries that don’t require explanation.
I mean the moment a woman stops prioritizing comfort over safety.

Women are often labeled “dangerous” when we stop being accessible.
But boundaries aren’t cruelty — they are survival.
They are self-respect.

Medusa wasn’t evil.
She was a woman who was harmed — and then awakened. 🐍✨
Hottest psychologist ever found by me

DID YOU KNOW? 😳

Sex and even thoughts of sex can temporarily increase testosterone levels — the hormone linked to beard growth.

Testosterone plays a key role in facial hair development, which is why some people believe sexual activity may “boost” beard growth. However, scientists say these hormonal spikes are usually short-lived and don’t dramatically change how fast your beard grows.

Genetics still remains the biggest factor behind thick or fast facial hair.

So yes, hormones matter — but DNA matters more. 🧬

You. Before starting the game a manual to remember Yourself was written & that is Bhagavad-Gita. Understand the game to play & then win/God, since only humans can playor fall down to lower forms of life/endless misery

Yo! My name is Nuel Bania, I make clothes for folks who appreciate clean fits, quality fabrics and unusual designs.

Strategic Thinking vs. Systems Thinking

Credit to Christian Rebernik, follow him for more practical content.

The gap between a good plan and great execution?
(Hint: It’s not what you think.)

❌ It’s not ambition.
❌ It’s not resources.
❌ It’s not even talent.

It’s in your thinking.

20+ years working with founders taught me this:

Most stop their thinking at strategy.

💥 They craft bold visions.
💥 They set clear priorities.
💥 They pour energy into designing a roadmap.

And, sure, it feels like progress.
But strategy alone doesn’t build momentum.

Because even the smartest plan will stall…
If the system beneath it can’t keep up.

That’s where systems thinking comes in.

The best founders use it to:

✅ See how parts of their business interact
✅ Spot friction before it slows them down
✅ Solve root causes, not just symptoms

It’s how they scale without breaking what’s
already working.

The shift:

Strategy sets the destination.
Systems thinking keeps you moving.

Used together, they create momentum that compounds.

Turning bold plans into real, scalable results.

The best leaders don’t choose between them.
They master both.

Follow @business__infographics to learn from the best visuals.

Most people apply strategic thinking to their career and systems thinking to nothing. The ones who win apply systems thinking to themselves — sleep, nutrition, mental inputs, daily structure. Your life is the most important system you’ll ever manage.🔥❤️
This is a great view, and not seen it out in this way before. Im a systems thinker mostly. But if you get too bogged down in you lose the reason for the system in the first place
Balancing strategic direction with strong systems creates scalable growth.
u need to map out the systems before u can be strategic about it. These 2 are complementary

The Sindh government has suspended Professor Azhar Shah, the pro vice chancellor of Sindh University’s Dadu campus, after viral videos on social media sparked allegations of intoxication, use of inappropriate language and disruption of academic activities.⁠

🧠 For ADHD (The Dopamine Gap):
The Science: Your brain is starved for Dopamine. You need to "feed" it in healthy ways to stop the chaos.
1. The "Pomodoro" Technique:
• Work for 25 mins -> Break for 5 mins.
• Why: Small bursts of focus give your brain "Mini-Rewards" (Dopamine hits) that keep it engaged.
• Study: [Wang et al., 2018 - Cognitive Control in ADHD]
2. Body Doubling:
• Sit with a friend or use a "Study with Me" video while working.
• Why: The presence of another person acts as a "Social Anchor" for your brain.
3. Omega-3 & Protein:
• High protein breakfast increases neurotransmitter production.
• Study: [Bloch & Qawasmi, 2011 - Omega-3 Fatty Acids in ADHD]
🛡️ For PTSD (The Stuck Alarm):
The Science: Your Amygdala (Fear Center) is stuck on "High Alert." You need to manually switch it off.
1. The "5-4-3-2-1" Grounding Technique:
• Identify 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, 1 you taste.
• Why: It forces your brain to focus on the Present, breaking the flashback loop.
2. EMDR Therapy (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing):
• The "Gold Standard" treatment. Moving your eyes side-to-side while recalling trauma helps the brain "digest" the memory.
• Study: [Nature Neuroscience - Amygdala Reprogramming]
3. Tetris Effect:
• Crazy Fact: Playing Tetris within hours of a traumatic event can reduce flashbacks. It occupies the visual cortex so the bad memory can't "save" properly.
• Study: [Iyadurai et al., 2009 - Tetris & Trauma]
You aren't broken. You just need a different manual. 🫂
#ADHD #MentalHealth #PTSD #BrainFacts #Dopamine

node.text:
Before you judge an Artist by his headlines or his controversies, remember that we celebrate Einstein, Oppenheimer, Gandhi, even Kanye—flawed humans, massive contributions. Everyone has their personal storms. Genius and flaws often party together! So next time, turn down the gossip, turn up the music, and maybe you’ll find the brilliance you’ve been missing!
Maybe give MC Stan’s music a real listen. 
Sometimes genius is louder than the noise.
All we need to do is replace our flawed judgements with curiosity. 

#desihiphop #indianhiphop #artvsartist #mcstan #nojudgement

What Happened: In a surprising incident in India, a mother who found her son with his girlfriend at a metro station chose an unexpected response, she immediately arranged their engagement on the spot.

What you need to know: According to witnesses, the woman decided not to entertain excuses or allow the relationship to remain secret. Instead of creating a scene or delaying the matter with long family discussions, she acted quickly to formalise the relationship. Onlookers said she made it clear that there would be no more hidden meetings or secrecy, turning what could have been an awkward moment into a life-changing decision for the couple.

node.text:
Most beginners use auth libraries without understanding them.
This is how real login systems actually work. 🔐
Save this for your next project ⭐️

#programming #computerscience #engineering #authentication #learning

Its not suitable for production, if you are going to deploy your app on the internet, then you have to take care of a lot of things like token rotations, rate-limits, xss and SQLi protection, session invalidation, etc…. You should use some third party auth provider and do the customisations by yourself if you want to develop a production grade app while being a beginner!

node.text:
History isn’t random. It leaves patterns.
Jewish communities were expelled from:
• England (1290)
• France (1306)
• Spain (1492)
And many other regions across medieval Europe.
These weren’t isolated incidents. They were political decisions shaped by debt crises, religious tensions, scapegoating during plagues, and power struggles between monarchies and the Church.

The bigger picture?
Expulsions weren’t just about religion. They were about power, control, and redirecting public anger.
History shows us something uncomfortable

Understanding that pattern isn’t about reliving the past.

It’s about recognizing how narratives are weaponized.

Follow @ww3politics for deeper geopolitical and historical breakdowns.

Voicebox is a desktop app for voice cloning and speech synthesis. Feed it a few seconds of audio and it clones the voice using models like Qwen3-TTS. Then you arrange the generated speech on a timeline — drag clips around, layer different voices, edit the output like you would in a DAW. Includes Whisper for transcription so you can edit based on the actual text. Runs locally. No cloud processing, no subscription.

https://github.com/jamiepine/voicebox

You honestly can’t make this up. In a Muslim-majority country ((Pakistan), MPA saying alcohol is necessary, while a Hindu MPA is the one asking for a ban. 
Where are our scholars and Muftis now? 
#pakistan #karachi #punjab #muslim #woman
حرام زادہ ک********* کیسے پاکستانیوں کو علماء کرام سے گمراہ کر رہا ہے او گانڈو اگر ہمت ہے تو اجا میرے ساتھ ڈیبیٹ کر لے
تیرے گھر میں اگے کوئی تیری بونڈ میں مار جائے نا تو نے اس کا الزام بھی مولویوں پہ لگا دینا ہے یہ مولویوں کی وجہ سے ہوا ہے😂

node.text:
WEXFO Young Experts express strong support for Imaan Mazari‑Hazir, who, together with her husband, has been sentenced to 17 years in prison in Pakistan for her critical statements about the authorities on social media.
 
On Friday, 30 January, the Young Experts – led here by @johanne.fearnley – delivered a joint statement to the Embassy of Pakistan in Oslo calling for a fair trial, withdrawal of the charges, immediate release, and protection from further persecution.
 
Imaan Mazari‑Hazir received the WEXFO Young Inspiration Award 2025 in Lillehammer, and was scheduled to return to Lillehammer in June 2026 as one of the keynote speakers at the World Expression Forum under the theme “Freedom to Disagree.”
 
We are deeply concerned about the imprisonment of Imaan Mazari‑Hazir, and about her safety and legal protection.
The comment section is filled with “why don’t you speak up against ___” or “well what about ____” . How about you pay attention and spread the message that is being spread  right now.

Attraction is not just about looks, it’s about social signals. How people talk about you, how they respect you, how you handle pressure, and how stable you appear in uncertain situations. These cues silently communicate safety, and when it comes to long-term attraction and choosing a partner, safety always beats excitement.

This is why desperation kills attraction, emotional instability lowers respect, and constant validation-seeking backfires. Confidence isn’t loud behaviour, it’s calm control. How you manage difficult situations, how you regulate your emotions, and whether your self-worth depends on approval tells far more about you than your words ever will. Attraction is less about what you say, and more about what your nervous system communicates.

node.text:
The first moments following the occupation’s targeting of a mourning house belonging to the Abu Al-Rus family in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza. 

اللحظات الأولى عقب استهداف الاحـ ـتلال بيت عزاء لعائلة أبو الروس في مخيم النصـ ـيرات وسط قطاع غـ ـزة.
The genocidal fascist government of Israel, led by Satanyahu, must be arrested and condemned for the good of humanity!
يارب يارب اللهم انتقم من اليهود الصهاينه الكفره اللهم ارنا فيهم يوم اسود كمثل قوم عاد وثمود يارب انهم طغوا فى البلاد فاكثروا فيه الفساد
حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل اللهم ارنا فى بنى صهيون أيات أشد وأعظم مما نزل فى أبائهم الأولين
لاحول ولا قوة الا بالله العلي العظيم

Sounds scammy.
It isn’t.

It’s a 3.5 hour talk by Naval.
I watched the whole thing and took notes so you don’t have to.

The idea isn’t working harder.
It’s ownership.

Jobs pay you for time.
Ownership pays you for judgment.

Code. Media. Products.
Things that keep working when you’re not.

The uncomfortable truth is that before leverage works, you don’t look ambitious.
You look behind.

That’s usually when people tell you to get a normal job.
To be safe.
To stop.

But long term games, with long term people, and leverage are the only things that compound.

This is just what it looks like before it works.

If you’re quietly learning and choosing the harder path, you’re not alone.
Naval's contents; I resonate with it.

You deserve a follow! 
Let’s go

node.text:
The Pakistan Army has been implicated in significant casualties among Muslim populations in several conflicts, though estimates vary widely due to differing sources and politicization.In East Pakistan (now Bangladesh) during the 1971 Liberation War, the military’s Operation Searchlight and subsequent operations targeted Bengali nationalists and civilians. Independent estimates place deaths at 300,000 to 500,000 Bengalis (mostly Muslims), with some higher claims reaching 3 million and lower official Pakistani figures around 26,000 civilians; widespread rape and displacement also occurred amid efforts to suppress autonomy demands.

In Balochistan, ongoing counter-insurgency operations against separatist groups like the Baloch Liberation Army have resulted in hundreds of militant deaths in recent clashes (e.g., reports of 41 to over 140 killed in military raids and responses in early 2026), alongside civilian and security force losses. The Baloch population, predominantly Muslim, has faced allegations of enforced disappearances and repression in this long-running conflict.

Pakistan had direct military killings in Palestine, during Black September (1970) in Jordan, Brigadier (later General) Zia-ul-Haq assisted Jordanian forces in suppressing Palestinian fedayeen, contributing to an estimated 2,000–3,400 Palestinian deaths (some claims higher, up to 25,000), many civilians, in clashes that expelled the PLO from Jordan. 

These cases highlight instances where Pakistani military actions or support aligned against Muslim groups in pursuit of strategic or allied interests.

"Perhaps the most significant implication of atheism — at least of the naturalist variety — is the foregoing of objective morality. If all that exists in the naturalist worldview is physical matter, then only that physical matter can be real. Moral values and beliefs are mere constructions of the human mind.

To say that anything is merely a product of the mind’s activity, with no independent existence beyond that, is to deny the objective reality of that thing. The atheist, therefore, cannot help but conclude that morality deals with subjective opinions, not objective facts.

This view, that moral frameworks are merely agreements between human beings and nothing more, is widely popular today. However, this subjective conception of morality poses a serious challenge to our ordinary use of moral language and our innate understanding of the nature of moral beliefs."

To read the full opinion, head to the link in bio.

#DawnToday
nhilism is what stems out as the most vicious implication. a society with or without objective  can have a chance of survival or evolve. a nhilist one cannot

I think the biggest shortcoming In an atheistic society is this that all the morals and rules are subject to popular opinion due to lack of a moral grundnorm. Which renders morality a fluctuating norm rather than a universally accepted rule.
If you need a collar around your neck to not rape, pillage, and murder. Maybe its time to reevaluate.

This is such an infuriatingly stupid Zakir Naik style argument. You cannot ground objective morality in God. Look up the Euthyphro dilemma, which goes back to Plato. Also, you cannot equate goodness with God’s desire, pleasure, etc. because that’s committing a naturalistic fallacy

She wasn’t asked at the time of her nikkah!
Fact: Asking the woman and man 3 times ‘Qubool hai’ is culture! Its not a requirement!
Mujhey toh yeh bhi ni poucha gaya tha ke mera waqeel kon ho ga and if I grant him the right to be it or not 🫠
Saari baatain theek hain, but serious lia krain. Easy na ho gng take everything seriously
I gave my consent to my father, and I didn’t say qabool hai in gathering type nikah. My father conveid my QABOOL to the molvi and other witnesses as he is my wali.

Same situation happened with me. First i was shocked why they didn't ask me that QUBOOL thing; Though i was totally willing for nikkah. Ap Walee apki agreement nikkah khwa ko bata dete hain or nikkah 💯 ho jata h.
Mere mama se bhi unki shady meh molvi nhi pocha tha😂 woh kehty ha ager pochta toh shayad mana ker dety 😂😂😂

Mujh sy bhe nhi pocha tha or nikh namy py singe bhe 10 din bad karwy register humary ghr chor gay thy bad mn ap sign Kara k register wapis kar dyna or aram sy mery husband ny sath beth k pics banwi thi
Even in huram sultan we've watched that she got married by consent through pasha....
Saari baatain theek hain, but serious lia krain. Easy na ho gng take everything seriously
Mujhey toh yeh bhi ni poucha gaya tha ke mera waqeel kon ho ga and if I grant him the right to be it or not 🫠

📈 If you’re a trader, this is the edge you’ve been looking for. "World Monitor" is an open-source masterpiece that turns global chaos into a real-time intelligence dashboard.

Forget scattered news feeds. This tool aggregates global news, map intelligence, and AI briefings into a single "war room" screen. The map is insane with over 25+ toggleable layers tracking everything from military hotspots and nuclear facilities to submarine cables and satellite fire detections. 

For macro and crypto traders, it features a built-in radar tracking BTC ETF flows, stablecoin depeg health, and real-time "Fear & Greed" signals. It’s like having a $20,000-a-year intelligence terminal for free.

Comment "MONITOR" below and I’ll DM you the GitHub link! 👇

Is this the ultimate tool for the 2026 macro era?

Behind global business, structure matters more than location. Multinational companies rarely operate through a single entity because different countries specialize in different roles operations, treaties, and ownership. Layered corporate structures allow businesses to separate where value is created from where it is governed and held. 

This isn’t about secrecy. It’s about coordination, compliance, and managing complexity across borders. Each layer exists for a reason: to reduce friction, clarify responsibilities, and align legal systems that were never designed to work together. 

As global commerce expanded, these structures became standard infrastructure. To understand how large companies operate internationally, you don’t follow headlines you follow the layers. Once you see the architecture, the outcomes make sense.

node.text:
While everyone was hyping Seedance 2.0…
China quietly dropped a free AI agent matching Claude’s benchmarks.

Day 47 of building 100X 🚀

It’s called MiniMax Agent.

Runs on:
• Mac
• Windows
• iPhone
• Android

Their new model M2.5 scores 80.2% on SWE-Bench.
Claude scores 80.8%.

That’s a 0.6% gap.

Claude? Hundreds of dollars per month.
MiniMax? Currently free.
Open source on Hugging Face.

And it runs at 100 tokens per second.

Most people missed it.
Because hype is louder than capability.

Comment MINIMAX for the link.

In the sacred traditions of Hinduism 🕉️ , this “wildness” is personified in the divine archetype of Maha Shakti, the primordial cosmic energy that animates all of existence. Specifically, it is seen in the form of Maa Kali—the wild, dancing Goddess who represents the ultimate freedom from social conditioning and the ego. Kali is often depicted in the cremation grounds, standing outside the boundaries of “polite” society, symbolizing that the feminine force is both the creator and the destroyer of illusions. As the Lalita Sahasranama describes the Divine Mother as Kshobhini (She who causes upheaval), we see that this wildness is a necessary force for spiritual evolution. Without the “wild beast” within the feminine, the world would remain stagnant and devoid of the fierce love required to break through the density of Maya. To be “wild” is to be in direct contact with the source of life before it is filtered through the mind. It is the raw, unadulterated power of the soul.

🎬 I WANT A DIVORCE 

The Childe (2023) 
is a dark, action-packed neo-noir thriller about Marco, a Kopino (Korean-Filipino) boxer in the Philippines trying to fund his sick mother's surgery. After a lawyer representing his rich, estranged father locates him, he travels to Korea, only to be chased by a mysterious, maniacal assassin known as "Noble".

Pakistan stock market is the BEST VENUE at the moment for you to raise money for your BUSINESS if you aren’t a Tax evader 💀

Why do they all look like mutants?

So who is committing the genocide? Why don’t they speak up?

Pakistani actor Naumaan Ijaz shared a humorous take on Valentine’s Day, joking that the word “Valentine” originally came from an old Punjabi phrase meaning “Vayle nu time de” (give time to the idle one). His witty remark quickly caught attention online, with fans appreciating his playful wordplay and cultural twist. Known for his sharp humor and thoughtful commentary, Naumaan’s statement added a lighthearted touch to the Valentine’s Day conversation, sparking laughter and reactions across social media.

node.text:
Activists disrupt #SOCAR party in London to protest its support for Israel.
Activists from “Fossil Free London” disrupted a SOCAR corporate event, denouncing the company’s complicity in supplying oil to the Israeli occupation. @fossilfreelondon

نشطاء يعترضون حفل شركة “سوكار” في لندن احتجاجاً على دعمها لإسرائيل.

عطّل نشطاء من حركة (Fossil Free London) حفلاً لشركة SOCAR، تنديداً بتورطها في توريد النفط للاحـ ـتلال الإسرائيلي.

Sending text-style messages over ham radio — no internet, no cell service.
This is why I take off-grid communications seriously. #hamradio #offgridcomms #emergencycommunications #prepardness
How to make such a device from scratch?
@pi.jma that's above my level of knowledge. I've never built a radio or computer from scratch. Thanks for watching! 🔥
@meridiansolutionsllc everything needed is in my Amazon store under HF digital messaging, commission helps the page! Link is in my bio. Thanks! 🔥
Is this the radio packages technology
Frequency mapping ur logs and decrypting it in seconds. Celestial communication is the only thing not infiltrated by the feds
How to make such a device from scratch?
@pi.jma that's above my level of knowledge. I've never built a radio or computer from scratch. Thanks for watching! 🔥
